title: Locally-Guided Actor-Critic: Training a Goal-conditioned Actor with a Subgoal-aware Critic
abstract: arXiv:2608.30406v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning struggles with long horizons when rewards are sparse. While a planner can provide subgoals to guide a low-level policy, its use at test time may introduce practical subgoal management difficulties. An alternative paradigm utilizes a high-level planner to assist learning, while the policy remains conditioned only on the final goal, enabling planner-free deployment. Among these methods, Reinforcement Learning with Imagined Subgoals (RIS) introduces a regularization term that encourages the policy to take the same actions for the final goal as it does for an intermediate goal. This regularization, however, may lead to goal-chaining issues when intermediate goals are low-dimensional. Potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) translates plans into an additional reward while ensuring that the optimal policy remains unchanged. Yet, it can generate deceptive rewards in terminal states. translated_title: 局部引导的Actor-Critic：使用子目标感知的Critic训练目标条件Actor
translated_abstract: 目标条件强化学习在奖励稀疏时难以应对长时程任务。虽然规划器可以提供子目标来引导低层策略，但在测试时使用规划器可能带来实际的子目标管理困难。另一种范式是利用高层规划器辅助学习，同时策略仅以最终目标为条件，从而实现无需规划器的部署。在这些方法中，基于想象子目标的强化学习（RIS）引入了一个正则化项，鼓励策略对最终目标采取与对中间目标相同的动作。然而，当中间目标是低维时，这种正则化可能导致目标链接问题。基于势能的奖励整形（PBRS）将规划转化为额外奖励，同时确保最优策略保持不变。然而，它可能在终止状态产生欺骗性奖励。我们研究了这些失败案例……
tldr: 提出局部引导的Actor-Critic方法，通过子目标感知的Critic来训练仅以最终目标为条件的Actor，实现规划器辅助学习但无需规划器部署，同时克服了RIS的目标链接问题和PBRS在终止状态的欺骗性奖励问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Locally-Guided Actor-Critic method that trains a goal-conditioned actor with a subgoal-aware critic, enabling planner-assisted learning with planner-free deployment while overcoming RIS's goal-chaining issues and PBRS's deceptive terminal rewards.
